# GD BetterLoot  
**优化原版建筑结构中的战利品生成**  

[![徽章 - 维基](https://img.shields.io/badge/-WIKI-2c2c2c?style=for-the-badge&logo=gitbook&logoColor=white)](https://gabriel-djalayer.gitbook.io/gdteam-wiki/projects/mods/gd-betterloot)  
[![徽章 - 源代码](https://img.shields.io/badge/-SOURCE-2c2c2c?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/GabrielDja/GD-BetterLoot)  
[![徽章 - Curseforge下载](https://img.shields.io/badge/ON-CURSEFORGE-_?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&labelColor=2c2c2c&color=e58e0e&logoColor=e58e0e)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/gd-betterloot)  
[![徽章 - Modrinth下载](https://img.shields.io/badge/ON-MODRINTH-_?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&labelColor=2c2c2c&color=17b95a&logoColor=17b95a)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/gd-betterloot)  
[![徽章 - 支持我们](https://img.shields.io/badge/-SUPPORT-6d30fd?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/gabrieldja)  
[![徽章 - GD团队](https://img.shields.io/badge/MY_WEBSITE-245cf3?style=for-the-badge)](https://gabrieldjalayer.wixsite.com/gabrieldja-gaming-yt)  

GD BetterLoot增加了战利品生成数量，你会发现大多数箱子几乎都是满的，并且还有一些额外的优化改进。

### 📜 许可证：MIT  
本数据包由**GabrielDja**制作。  

![GD BetterLoot 预览图](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/31958c_7e8bfcb6e7be4ff6a86ff91ba95a2493~mv2.png)  

## ⭐ 支持的结构  
- 远古城市  
- 沙漠神殿  
- 末地城  
- 雪屋  
- 丛林神庙  
- 废弃矿井  
- 海底废墟  

[**查看所有支持的结构**](https://github.com/GabrielDja/GD-BetterLoot#supported-structures)
